title: Etale base neighbourhood from a field or DVR stalk
statement: Let $R$ be a Noetherian integral domain [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] and $B$ a commutative $R$-algebra finite and torsion free as an $R$-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module]; torsion free means $rb=0$, $0\ne r\in R$, implies $b=0$. Let $\mathfrak p\subset R$ be a prime ideal, let $R_{\mathfrak p}$ be localization at that prime [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime], and assume $R_{\mathfrak p}$ is either a field or a discrete valuation ring [def-sc-discrete-valuation-ring]. Write $\kappa(\mathfrak p)=\operatorname{Frac}(R/\mathfrak p)$ and $F=B\otimes_R\kappa(\mathfrak p)$ [def-weil-module-base-change]. Suppose either (i) $\Omega_{F/\kappa(\mathfrak p)}=0$ [def-weil-pbc-kahler-differentials], or (ii) $F$ is a finite product of finite separable field extensions of $\kappa(\mathfrak p)$ (separable means minimal polynomials have distinct roots). Then there is $f\in R\setminus\mathfrak p$ such that $R[1/f]\to B[1/f]$ is etale [def-weil-etale-morphism, def-weil-ring-localization-away].

source.place: Tag 02GU, lemma-etale-at-point, (2), (4), (5); applied to finite maps and the closed image of the non-etale locus. Algebra Tag 00U3, lemma-etale-over-field, for (ii); finite torsion-free modules over a DVR are free. Agent-formulated base-neighbourhood consequence, also implicit in ILO IV 4.2.5.
